column2: Place: 새벽의 숲, a misty forest at dawn. Tall dark tree trunks, soft peach and teal morning light between them, mossy roots, a worn dirt path as the floor. Calm and inviting: the first area of the game.
Place: 홍련 화산, a volcanic cavern. Black basalt walls with glowing orange-red lava cracks, falling embers in the upper area, an obsidian rock floor with a faint red sheen.
Place: 황혼 성당, the inside of a ruined gothic cathedral at dusk. Tall arches, broken stained-glass windows lit purple and gold, a great bell hanging high in the top third, a cracked stone-tile floor.
Place: 별빛 정원, a garden at night under a starry sky. Hedges and arches with softly glowing pale flowers, a fountain silhouette far behind, a stone-tile garden path as the floor.
Place: 심야의 해구, a sunken temple at the bottom of a deep sea trench. Deep blue water, bioluminescent cyan corals and kelp, broken pillars, light rays from far above, a sandy seabed floor.
Place: 투기장, a colosseum arena. Stone tiers with a crowd only as tiny dark shapes far away, red banners and torches, a packed sand floor with faint chalk lines.
Place: 창조의 탑, the top of a celestial tower. White-gold marble pillars, floating stone platforms and clouds in the top third, a starry gold-violet sky, a polished marble floor with gold inlays.

Place: 꿈의 관측소, a cozy dream observatory at night, the home base of the game. A big brass telescope pointing up at an open dome full of stars, bookshelves, warm hanging lamps, a soft rug on a wooden floor. Warm and peaceful.
